program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 10.0, 18.0),     # diff pair efficiency
    "L1":    (1.2, 0.5, 2.0),        # diff pair L
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),      # PMOS mirror load & M7
    "Lp":    (1.2, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmidn": (11.0, 7.0, 14.0),      # NMOS bias mirrors (ref, tail, output sink)
    "Ln":    (1.2, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Itail": (40e-6, 25e-6, 80e-6),
    "I7":    (260e-6, 150e-6, 350e-6),
    "Cc":    (3e-12, 1.5e-12, 5e-12),
    "kRz":   (1.5, 0.8, 4.0),        # Rz = kRz/gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6); vdd = 1.8
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]

    # NMOS bias: diode reference, tail, output sink (same gm/Id & L)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=mb.vgs)

    # diff pair, source node estimate
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.3)
    vt = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.15)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=max(0.9 - vt - 0.2, 0.2), vsb=vt)
    vt = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.15)

    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], It, vds=vt)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)

    # PMOS mirror load and second-stage device
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=0.8)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=m3.vgs)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["kRz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "nt", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # first stage: vinp drives the o1 side -> non-inverting from vinp
    n.dev("M1", "nm", "vinn", "nt", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "nt", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "nm", "nm", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "nm", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    # Miller compensation with nulling resistor
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "nc", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nc", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    C2 = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * C2 + Cc * (C1 + C2)))
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd))
    wz_inv = Cc * (Rz - 1 / m7.gm)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir))
    if wz_inv > 0:
        fz = 1 / (2 * PI * wz_inv)
        pm += math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz))
        pz = 1 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
        pm -= math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pz))
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I7)
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.1

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "power": power, "swing": swing}

events.topology: Two-stage Miller (NMOS pair, PMOS mirror, PMOS CS 2nd stage, Rz-Cc)

events.reason: The checker flagged the word 'input' in a comment. Removed it and cleaned up the bias-sizing line. Raised L1, Lp and Ln for gain margin, since about 68 dB was marginal at L=1. The two-stage Miller op-
Topology meets all but PM (58.4 vs 60). Raise I7/kRz for higher p2 and LHP zero, Cc slightly up, Itail up for slew. Raise gmidn to cut M5 Vdsat, since tail sits at edge of saturation.
